items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 塩 (the salt) as that which receives the action of the verb 量る (to weigh). It is what was weighed.

items.jp: 電車に手袋を忘れました

translation.pt-BR: Esqueci minhas luvas no trem.
translation.en: I left my gloves on the train.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 手袋 (gloves) as what undergoes the action of forgetting.

items.jp: 特急の切符を二枚買いました

translation.pt-BR: Comprei duas passagens do trem expresso.
translation.en: I bought two express train tickets.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 特急の切符 as that which was bought.

items.jp: 卵を四つ使いました

translation.pt-BR: Usei quatro ovos.
translation.en: I used four eggs.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 卵 as that which receives the action of 使う (to use): it is the eggs that were used.

items.jp: やかんでお湯を沸かしている

translation.pt-BR: Estou esquentando água na chaleira.
translation.en: I'm heating water in the kettle.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 'お湯' (water) as what undergoes the action of the verb 沸かす.

items.jp: 布団を押入れにしまった

translation.pt-BR: Guardei o futon no armário embutido.
translation.en: I put the futon away in the closet.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 布団 (the futon) as the object undergoing the action of putting away.

items.jp: 庭に小さい木を植えました

translation.pt-BR: Plantei uma árvore pequena no jardim.
translation.en: I planted a small tree in the garden.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 木 (tree) as the object that directly receives the action of the verb 植える.
